description: England bus and coach stops near a point, nearest first. Pass `lat` and `lon` (WGS84), optional `radius_m` (1 to 2,000, default 500) and `limit` (1 to 50, default 10). Each stop carries its NaPTAN ATCO code `id` (pass it to `next_departures`), `name`, `indicator` (e.g. "Stop S"), `locality`, position, `distance_m` and `bearing_deg` from the point, and `lines`, the line names the Bus Open Data timetables have calling there. Bus and coach only: rail, tram, metro and ferry stops are not included, and coverage is England (plus stops just across a border that an England service calls at). Display data, never a journey plan: pass on the returned `label` and `coverage`. Requires the MapMap gateway; a deployment without the stops index answers a clear error. Display the returned `attribution` (NaPTAN and BODS, Open Government Licence v3.0).

lat.description: Latitude of the point, WGS84 degrees.

limit.description: Most stops to return, 1 to 50 (default 10), nearest first.

lon.description: Longitude of the point, WGS84 degrees.

name: nearby_stops

bearing_deg.description:
Bearing from the queried point to the stop, degrees clockwise from
true north.

distance_m.description: Straight-line distance from the queried point, metres.

id.description:
The NaPTAN ATCO code, e.g. "490008660N": pass it to
`next_departures`.

lines.description: Line names the timetable has calling at the stop.

attribution.description:
NaPTAN and BODS attribution (Open Government Licence v3.0): display
it with the stops.

coverage.description:
What the data covers (England bus and coach stops; no rail, tram or
ferry). Pass it on with the stops.

label.description:
What the answer is and is not: display data, never a journey plan
or an arrival prediction. Pass it on with the stops.

stops.description: Stops inside the radius, nearest first.
